author: Chris
title: PAID PROJECT – Looking to Hire an Animator / Unreal Engine Artist
content:
🚨 PAID PROJECT – Looking to Hire an Animator / Unreal Engine Artist / Creator

I’m looking for someone who can create a 10-minute “STREAM STARTING SOON” intro for my gaming streams.

Title: Stream Starting Soon - Cinematic Sunset Countdown

Resolution: 3840×2160 (4K UHD), 60 FPS
Length: Exactly 10:00 (600 seconds)
Style: Ultra-realistic environment with stylized animated fantasy characters, cinematic lighting, high-end game trailer quality.

Scene

A breathtaking open grassy field stretches to the horizon with wildflowers gently swaying in the breeze. Tall oak trees border the landscape while distant mountains frame the background.

The video begins in late afternoon with warm golden sunlight.

Over the course of exactly 10 minutes, the sun slowly descends across the sky in real time until the final second, where it disappears below the horizon and the sky transitions into twilight with stars beginning to appear.

The lighting should continuously evolve with realistic global illumination, volumetric sun rays, long shadows, lens flare, and subtle atmospheric haze.

Characters

Populate the field with dozens of original game-inspired characters:

stealth operative wearing tactical gear
colorful elemental creature trainers with original companion monsters
voxel-style block adventurers
fantasy knights
space marines
ninjas
robots
mages
archers
dragons
goblins
pirates
futuristic soldiers
cute fantasy creatures

The characters should constantly roam, duel, cast spells, swing swords, shoot arrows, dodge, celebrate victories, and interact playfully. Combat should be stylized and non-graphic with colorful visual effects.

Every few seconds, different groups encounter each other, creating a living battlefield with no single focal point.

Environment Animation

Birds flying overhead
Butterflies passing the camera
Leaves drifting in the wind
Grass reacting to wind
Clouds slowly moving
Rabbits and deer occasionally crossing the field
Fireflies appearing during the last two minutes

Overlay

Center of screen:

STREAM STARTING SOON

Elegant white cinematic font with a soft glow.

Top-left corner:

A large digital countdown timer beginning at:

10:00

and ending at

00:00

The timer must update every second accurately.

Camera

The camera remains mostly stationary with extremely slow cinematic movement:

gentle floating motion
subtle parallax
occasional tiny zoom adjustments
no sudden cuts

The entire video should be one continuous seamless shot.

Audio

Ambient only:

birds
wind through grass
distant waterfalls
soft fantasy ambience
insects at dusk
no dialogue
no music

Quality

Photorealistic environment
AAA game cinematic quality
Ultra-sharp textures
Ray-traced lighting
HDR color grading
Physically accurate shadows
Smooth 60 FPS animation
No jitter
No looping artifacts
Broadcast-quality suitable for Twitch and YouTube livestreams

#Hiring #3DAnimation #UnrealEngine #Blender
